title: n8n before 1.123.85, 2.x before 2.43.5, and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 stores credential secrets in execution error data…
description: n8n versions before 1.123.85, 2.x before 2.43.5, and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 improperly store credential secrets in execution error data for certain nodes. This exposure occurs when operations fail in the Git, MongoDB Atlas Vector Store, and Google Cloud Storage nodes. Users with permission to view workflow executions but without credential read access can extract sensitive secrets such as Git passwords or tokens, MongoDB passwords, and Google access tokens from the error data.
